title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
description: Ten named Loyola spaces documented for studying, gathering, recreation, or planning campus life.

cards.title: Loyola Quad
cards.subtitle: Evergreen Campus green space
cards.notes: Bring a book or meet a classmate outdoors; Loyola lists the Quad among its suggested places to study and spend time with other students.
cards.short_summary: A campus green where studying and social time can overlap.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola's first-generation student FAQ names the Loyola Quad as a suggested study and social space.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus space; follow current campus access guidance.

cards.title: Hammock Village
cards.subtitle: Behind Campion Tower
cards.notes: Use this named outdoor stop behind Campion Tower for a low-key pause or reading break, as Loyola suggests it for study and social time.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor hangout identified in Loyola's student-success guidance.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola's FAQ lists the hammock village behind Campion Tower among suggested social and study spaces.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus location behind Campion Tower; observe posted seasonal or campus rules.

cards.title: Center for Intercultural Engagement
cards.subtitle: Andrew White Student Center, E317
cards.notes: Drop in for dialogue, networking, celebration, or programming; the community kitchen is available to campus community members for commuter-friendly use.
cards.short_summary: A centrally located gathering space for dialogue, programs, and connection.
cards.evidence_claim: The CIE provides space for dialogue, networking, celebration, and programming, and includes a community kitchen accessible to campus community members.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists daily hours; contact the program assistant to reserve the space for an event.

cards.title: Starbucks Area
cards.subtitle: Andrew White Student Center, first floor
cards.notes: Use the first-floor Student Center seating as a casual meeting point or study change of scene; Loyola names this area in its campus-space suggestions.
cards.short_summary: A named Student Center area suggested for student social and study time.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola's FAQ identifies the Starbucks area on the first floor of the Student Center as a suggested study and social space.
cards.access_notes: Inside the Andrew White Student Center; seating availability may vary with campus operations.

cards.title: Humanities Center Porch
cards.subtitle: Adjacent to Loyola Quad
cards.notes: Step onto the porch next to the Quad when you want an outdoor place to read or catch up; Loyola includes it in its campus-space suggestions.
cards.short_summary: A porch-side outdoor option beside the Quad.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola's FAQ lists the Humanities Center porch, adjacent to the Loyola Quad, as a suggested study and social space.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor area adjacent to the Loyola Quad; observe building and weather conditions.

cards.title: Loyola/Notre Dame Library
cards.subtitle: 200 Winston Avenue
cards.notes: Reserve a study space or choose between private and group rooms, computers, research materials, gaming, and flexible seating for your next work session.
cards.short_summary: A library with reservable study space and both quiet and collaborative options.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola lists private and group study rooms, computers, research materials, a virtual gaming room, and flexible seating at the Loyola/Notre Dame Library.
cards.access_notes: Loyola directs students to reserve a study space; check the library's current access and reservation policies.

cards.title: The Study
cards.subtitle: Jenkins Hall, third floor
cards.notes: Bring your Loyola ID for a workstation, scanner, desk, or reading chair; this academic space also hosts tutoring and has published operating hours.
cards.short_summary: A credentialed academic workspace with computers, seating, and tutoring connections.
cards.evidence_claim: The Study has computers, workstations, desks, scanners, lounge seating, and requires entrants to present a valid Loyola ID.
cards.access_notes: Valid Loyola ID required. Posted hours: Sun noon–10 p.m.; Mon–Thu 9 a.m.–10 p.m.; Fri 9 a.m.–4 p.m.

cards.entity_name: The Lounge at the Fitness & Aquatic Center
cards.title: FAC Lounge
cards.subtitle: Fitness & Aquatic Center
cards.notes: Settle in between activities to relax, eat, or study; Loyola describes this dedicated lounge as an inviting area for all three uses.
cards.short_summary: A recreation-center lounge that supports breaks, food, and study time.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola describes The Lounge at the FAC as an inviting area for students to relax, eat, or study.
cards.source_title: Facilities | Department of Recreation and Wellness
cards.access_notes: Located within the FAC; access is subject to facility membership and current operating policies.

cards.title: Indoor Rock Climbing Wall
cards.subtitle: Fitness & Aquatic Center, first floor
cards.notes: Try an introductory climb or return for a route session; Loyola says the 30-foot wall and bouldering area are designed for all skill levels.
cards.short_summary: A 30-foot climbing and bouldering space inside the FAC.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola states that the FAC's indoor climbing wall is 30 feet high, includes a bouldering area, and is designed for all skill levels.
cards.source_title: Facilities | Department of Recreation and Wellness
cards.access_notes: Located on the FAC first floor; check the facility for current climbing-wall availability and requirements.

cards.title: Outdoor Adventure Basecamp
cards.subtitle: Fitness & Aquatic Center, Room 233
cards.notes: Stop by to sign up for an outing, consult books or topographic maps, or ask attendants for help planning an outdoor trip or equipment rental.
cards.short_summary: The Outdoor Adventures home base for trip planning and gear resources.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola identifies Basecamp in FAC Room 233 as a place to sign up for trips, use its resource library, and rent basic camping equipment.
cards.source_title: Basecamp | Department of Recreation and Wellness
cards.access_notes: Official page lists fall and spring-semester hours only; it is closed during breaks, exams, and summer.
